title: Science and technology in everyday life
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a technika szerepéről a mindennapjaidban, a mesterséges intelligenciáról és a tudományról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: Which piece of technology has had the biggest impact on your life? Why?
How would your life be different without a smartphone?
followUps: Have you ever tried a digital detox?

questions.q: Do you use artificial intelligence tools, for example chatbots? What for?
Should students be allowed to use AI for their homework? Why or why not?
Are you interested in any area of science? Which one, and why?
followUps: Where do you learn about it?

questions.q: How do you protect your privacy online?
Do you think technology brings people closer together or pushes them apart?
Which scientific discovery or invention do you think has been the most important in history?
Why do you think fewer girls than boys choose careers in engineering or IT?
Which problem would you most like scientists to solve in your lifetime?

usefulPhrases.en: It has transformed the way I ...

It depends on how you use it.
